name: Harvest Mania to Go
summary: Harvest Mania to Go gives fledgling farmers a quick lesson in agriculture, or just a veggie good way to pass the time. "Classic" mode involves matching colored vegetables in groups of four or more. Creating longer chains will earn a player bonus points that can be converted into tokens to enter into the Pogo website for a chance to win up to $1,000. As the seasons change, a new vegetable is harvested and a player's rank will increase. The different crop gives the gamer a chance to earn bonus items such as animals, flowers, and rocks for their farm. In "Action" mode, players get the chance to create a farm, fertilize and seed it, and then harvest before the garden grows out of control.
